tagline: Owning and operating community-centered commercial properties in culturally diverse markets across major metropolitan areas
hero_kpi_rationale: The 89% occupancy rate is a key indicator of operational health and rental demand for a REIT, reflecting the ability to generate stable revenue despite a concentrated lease renewal schedule.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from leasing commercial spaces.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $161 million in 2025, up $7 million from 2024, driven by new leases and rental rate increases.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue retained after deducting direct costs, typically high for REITs.
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately 68.5% in 2025, based on revenue of $161M and gross asset value of $1.4B.
kpis.signal: High gross margin typical of REITs

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating income to total revenue, reflecting operational efficiency.
kpis.description: Calculated at approximately 25.1% in 2025, reflecting efficient internal management despite operating costs.
kpis.signal: Healthy operating margin for a REIT

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: 72 employees as of December 31, 2025, consistent with a fully-integrated and internally-managed REIT model.

kpis.name: Gross Leasable Area
kpis.explanation: Total space available for leasing in shopping centers, measured in millions of square feet.
kpis.description: 4.9 million square feet of gross leasable area as of December 31, 2025, distributed across 56 properties in Texas and Arizona.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rental space currently leased relative to available space.
kpis.description: Approximately 89% of spaces were leased in 2025, despite 29% of leases expiring before end of 2027.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate despite near-term lease expirations

kpis.name: Lease Expirations (Proportion)
kpis.explanation: Share of space with leases expiring before end of 2027.
kpis.description: 29% of leasable area is subject to lease expirations before end of 2027, a risk managed through an early renewal program with a historical success rate of 75%.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $1.17B in latest year

kpis.name: Redemption Recovery
kpis.explanation: Amount received from settlement of a joint venture debt claim in bankruptcy.
kpis.description: $33.4 million received on December 12, 2025 pursuant to a settlement agreement with Pillarstone OP following bankruptcy. Additional amount of approximately $4M expected in 2026.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Illiquidity of Properties
risks.score_rationale: Real estate properties are illiquid due to factors such as sale restrictions and lengthy sales timelines, which can result in prolonged losses and reduce cash flow.

risks.title: Project Development
risks.score_rationale: Development projects may be affected by delays or difficulties in obtaining permits, financing availability, and leasing properties.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation can negatively impact the company's financial results by increasing operating costs and reducing tenants' ability to pay rent.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces intense competition in the real estate market, which can lead to reduced rental rates and increased marketing costs.

risks.title: Pandemics
risks.score_rationale: Pandemics can significantly impact the company's financial results by reducing revenue and increasing operating costs.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk related to tenants' ability to pay rent, which can negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations that can impact financial results, including regulations regarding accessibility for persons with disabilities.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its SEC filings. Its business appears to focus on real estate management and associated financial aspects.
